name: Thanh Le-Cong
title: Assistant Professor
university: Singapore University of Technology and Design (SUTD)
bio: I am a tenure-track Assistant Professor at the ISTD Pillar, Singapore University of Technology and Design (SUTD). I am currently completing my Ph.D. at the University of Melbourne, advised by Dr. Bach Le and Prof. Toby Murray. I was one of two recipients of the Google PhD Fellowship in Software Engineering and Programming Technology in 2023. My research focuses on trustworthy automated programming for building reliable and secure software systems. I work on two main tracks: (1) evaluating and enhancing the trustworthiness of AI-enabled software development and (2) developing AI-driven automated software debugging approaches, focusing vulnerability detection and repair. My work has published at premier software engineering, e.g., ICSE, FSE, TOSEM, TSE, and natural language processing venues, e.g., ACL.

news.text: Excited to share that I have graduated with my PhD from the University of Melbourne.
Invited to serve on the PC of ICSE and FSE 2027.
Glad to give an invited talk on Software Security at Phenikaa University.
Happy to share that our papers on LLM-based program repair and membership inference attacks accepted at ICSE 2026.
Excited to share that I have successfully presented my PhD completion seminar at the University of Melbourne.
Glad to give an invited talk on Trustworthy Automatic Programming at SUTD.
